description: Production Evals registry for Nexxus Connect v2.2. Structured to mirror the existing sprints.json style while shifting from shallow pass/fail testing to section-based evaluation sprints.

sprints.name: AI Chat / Main Dashboard — UI Behavior, Metric Credibility, and Drill-Down Truth
sprints.source: Production Evals methodology + operator review + U-001 reconciliation + user stories
sprints.outcome: AI Chat is evaluated as an operator-visible dashboard, not just a passing route. Chat behavior, scroll behavior, store switching, visible metrics, drill-downs, contact detail usefulness, and data plausibility are proven or rejected with evidence.
acceptanceCriteria: PE-AI-CHAT-01.AC1: Section / page function map states what AI Chat does in interface terms, including chat area, metric tiles, drill-downs, and store context.
PE-AI-CHAT-01.AC2: Chat response behavior is evaluated for auto-scroll, rendering stability, and visible usability with evidence and commentary.
PE-AI-CHAT-01.AC3: Store switching is evaluated across at least the currently questioned dealerships and the visible metrics are assessed for plausibility, not just rendering.
PE-AI-CHAT-01.AC4: Metric tiles and drill-downs are evaluated for visible truth, contradiction checks, and operator usefulness.
PE-AI-CHAT-01.AC5: Contact detail states opened from drill-downs are evaluated for meaningfulness, actionability, and data credibility.
PE-AI-CHAT-01.AC6: Every executed flow has evidence, commentary, and a result status.
PE-AI-CHAT-01.AC7: Bugs are logged with severity, type, and false-pass classification where applicable.
PE-AI-CHAT-01.AC8: Post-sprint review includes confidence assessment and recommendation.
entryGates: A1: Relevant governance and product sources read (production-evals pack, CLAUDE.md, relevant sprints.json context, feature map, U-001 evidence, user stories).
A2: Scope limited to AI Chat / Main Dashboard only.
A3: User story gate satisfied — expected behavior defined in concrete interface terms.
A4: Pre-execution report exists with function map, use cases, acceptance matrix, evidence plan, and bug handling plan.
A5: Irreversible actions approved or explicitly excluded.
A6: Worktree clean if remediation is authorized.
A7: Ghost / enforcer / operator messages clear.
A8: Sprint registered in sprints.json with status committed.
A9: Ghost Entry Gate — ENTRY GATE: APPROVED in pre-execution-report.md.
exitGates: B1: All planned AI Chat flows have execution reports.
B2: Evidence and commentary exist for each executed flow.
B3: Data plausibility checks are documented for metric-heavy flows.
B4: Drill-down and contact-detail usefulness are explicitly assessed.
B5: Bugs are logged with status and false-pass classification where relevant.
B6: Remediation retests completed or explicitly deferred.

playwrightPrinciple: Playwright is the witness, not the judge.
programGoals: Replace shallow automated testing with evidence-backed human-AI evaluation sprints.
Evaluate data accuracy, UI behavior consistency, and cross-screen workflow outcomes.
Force explicit acceptance criteria, narrative commentary, and false-pass detection.
Run remediation and exact-flow retest loops until flows are accepted or explicitly deferred.

subAgentRoles.name: Eval Orchestrator
responsibilities: Select and restate the active sprint in interface terms.
Enforce one-sprint-at-a-time and one-flow-at-a-time discipline.
Sequence use cases and stop scope drift.
Coordinate final acceptance recommendations.

subAgentRoles.name: Playwright Operator
responsibilities: Execute UI flows.
Capture screenshots, route state, DOM snapshots, console notes, and network anomalies.
Prove visible state transitions and persistence after refresh when relevant.

subAgentRoles.name: Data Verifier
responsibilities: Check metric plausibility and contradictions.
Compare drill-downs, counts, filters, activity feeds, and store context.
Validate downstream truth in TeamBox, campaigns, and CRM-linked flows.

subAgentRoles.name: Integration Verifier
responsibilities: Compare provider-side truth to Nexxus-side truth for TextMagic, VAPI, Tavus, Resend, and Vin Solutions.
Flag provider-only passes as false passes if Nexxus truth is absent or wrong.

subAgentRoles.name: Evidence Scribe
responsibilities: Index every artifact by sprint, use case, and acceptance criterion.
Ensure evidence meets the required tier.
Write concise proof statements for each artifact.

subAgentRoles.name: Bug and Remediation Analyst
responsibilities: Classify defects by severity, type, and false-pass class.
Describe operator and business impact.
Require exact-flow retests after approved fixes.

subAgentRoles.name: Governance Enforcer
responsibilities: Block unauthorized irreversible actions.
Require pre-execution package before execution.
Block sprint acceptance if evidence or commentary is incomplete.

playwrightCollaborationRules: Playwright may execute, observe, and capture evidence, but it may not self-certify acceptance.
Every flow needs before/after proof, expected-vs-actual commentary, and a result status.
A visible contradiction overrides green assertions.
Provider success without correct Nexxus materialization is a false pass.
After any fix, rerun the exact failing flow and adjacent risk flows when warranted.
Do not continue to the next sprint until the current sprint has a post-sprint review.

triggers: Test passes but UI is visibly wrong.
DOM shows an element but the operator experience is broken.
Provider or webhook log shows success but Nexxus UI is missing or wrong.
Navigation technically occurs but lands in the wrong or useless state.
Numbers render but are implausible or contradictory.
Early steps succeed but downstream continuity breaks.

minimumArtifacts: DOM snapshot or state proof when relevant
console or network notes when relevant
